attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: Alexander Grenkov, sixth of the eight children of Michael Theodorovich Grenkov and Martha Nikolaevna, born at Great Lipovitsa in the Tambov region on 23 November 1812, a seminarian and then a teacher, a monk at Optina, deacon on 2 February 1843 and priest at the end of 1845, dead on 10 October 1891 and canonised in 1990. The page states those dates, so a `dates` object is proposed from its own words. It prints no hymn for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).
